question: A thick, electrically neutral, conducting spherical shell has an inner radius $R$ and an outer radius $2R$. A point charge $+q$ is placed at the center of the shell. The entire system is then placed in a uniform external electric field $E₀$ that points in the positive x-direction. What is the ratio of the net surface charge density at point A (located at $x=2R$ on the outer surface) to that at point B (located at $x=-2R$ on the outer surface)?
